title: Final Velocity Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for terminal velocity, v_term = (1024 * m * g * R^4) / (45 * mu_0^2 * mu^2 * sigma * t).

title: Induced Current Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the expression for the induced current in the conducting tube based on the induced electric field.

title: Force Balance Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain how the balance of forces (induced magnetic force and gravitational force) leads to the terminal velocity condition.

title: Use of Integral
description: Important Criteria: The student should utilize the provided integral correctly in the context of the problem to compute the total induced force.

title: Sign Convention
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes, particularly in the direction of forces and induced currents.
